package.description: Modern 4K YouTube video and MP3 audio extractor with native Hebrew/RTL support.

en-US.author: Sagive
en-US.description: Modern 4K YouTube video and MP3 audio extractor with native Hebrew/RTL support.
en-US.longDescription: BT YouTube Downloader is a high-performance desktop application for downloading YouTube videos in resolutions up to 4K UHD and extracting high-fidelity MP3/AAC audio. Built with CustomTkinter, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg, it features native right-to-left (RTL) rendering and bilingual English/Hebrew interface support.
en-US.name: BT YouTube Downloader
